summary.implementedScope: Implemented Story 0 foundation support for the Session Context Store by adding canonical record and error vocabularies, deterministic id/fingerprint and target-key helpers, reusable test fixtures and temp-store scaffolding, and repo verification/test scripts with the required foundation coverage.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

evidence: 005-verify.json raised the realpath-based target-key blocker; quick-fix 001 completed; 007-verify.json has openFindings empty and verifies S0-id-target-range-fingerprint-helpers.
006-verify.json raised the PI fixture-builder contract blocker; quick-fix 002 completed; 007-verify.json has openFindings empty and verifies S0-test-fixture-builders.

changedFiles.reason: Added the Story 0 verification/test script contract: test, red-verify, verify, green-verify, verify-all, test:integration, and guard:no-test-changes.
Expanded TypeScript coverage to include the new test files.
Added a small test runner helper so unit and integration scripts can discover TypeScript tests and gracefully handle the current no-integration-tests state.
Added the canonical steward error codes, issue shape, result type, and shared result helpers.
Added the canonical Session Context Store record vocabulary, schema constants, and pure thread/root-index initialization helpers.
Added deterministic content fingerprinting, stable-id helpers, source-range helpers, generated id helpers, and canonical target-session key derivation.
Added reusable canonical record builders, PI-shaped fixture builders, snapshot helpers, and shared test timestamps for downstream stories.
Added isolated temp project/store helpers for future filesystem-backed store and service tests.
Added the required Story 0 foundation tests covering deterministic helper behavior and schema-version/thread-initialization defaults.
